meta.name: craft-plugins
meta.description: Index and router for plugin-specific Craft CMS 5 guidance — configuration, Twig API, PHP/programmatic API, migrations, deployment, and pitfalls for the third-party plugins this pack documents. This skill exists so a plugin task is discoverable regardless of altitude: front-end (Twig/styling), back-end (PHP, content migrations, events), content modeling, or deployment all route here. Triggers whenever a task names one of these plugins in ANY context — build, configure, style, render, query, import, migrate, deploy, translate, cache, or debug: Formie (forms, form builder, submissions, File Upload field, form in a migration, form notifications), SEOmatic (meta, sitemaps, JSON-LD, SEO field), Blitz (static/page caching, purge, refresh), Feed Me (import XML/JSON/CSV feeds, scheduled import), Imager-X (image transforms, srcset, optimizers), ImageOptimize (OptimizedImages field, responsive images), CKEditor (rich text field, nested entries), Sprig (reactive components, htmx), Element API (JSON API endpoints), Retour
